TURBOCHARGER REMOVAL

Installation is in the reverse order of removal.
1. DRAIN ENGINE COOLANT
2. REMOVE ENGINE UNDER COVER
3. DISCONNECT CRUISE CONTROL ACTUATOR CABLE FROM THROTTLE BODY
4. REMOVE NO.1 AIR HOSE
5. REMOVE AIR CLEANER DUCT

6. REMOVE AIR CLEANER AND MAF METER ASSEMBLY
(a) Remove the 3 bolts.
(b) Loosen the hose clamp, disconnect the air hose from the intake air connector.
(c) Disconnect the MAF meter wire from the clamp on the air cleaner case.
(d) Disconnect the MAF meter connector, and remove the air cleaner and MAF meter assembly.
